description.value: Famous ROME Ice Cream is a family-run gelato and ice cream shop on Marine Drive in White Rock, opened in October 2021 by a Korean-Canadian family. Situated near the beach and pier, it offers over 50 flavours spanning gelato, sorbetto, and ice cream — including a dedicated kid's zone and vegan-friendly sorbetto — alongside coffee, tea, and handmade baked goods. The outdoor seating and waterfront location make it a natural refreshment stop for cyclists on the White Rock waterfront.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched and is rich with detail. The site explicitly lists 'take-out' and 'Outdoor seating' as features, and 'No delivery' as a confirmed negative. Vegan options are confirmed via 'Sorbetto for Vegan (non-dairy)' on the products page. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging anywhere on the site, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM phone field is empty; phone number 778-891-4809 sourced from website only — no OSM value to confirm against.
Contact email on website is a personal Gmail address (cjh4423@gmail.com), which is typical for small family businesses but worth noting.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A food-and-drink stop with takeout, outdoor seating, and vegan options on the White Rock waterfront — a well-known cycling corridor. The business appears active and well-documented.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website products page lists 'Sorbetto for Vegan (non-dairy)' with multiple flavours (Strawberry, Mango, Lemon, Passion fruit, etc.) and 'No Sugar Added' gelato options

wow_evidence: family-run gelato and ice cream shop on Marine Drive in White Rock... near the beach and pier
